text_en: Then all the tribes of Israel came to David at Hebron, and said, “Look, we are your bone and flesh.
text_cn: 以色列各支派聚集到赫贝龙，来见达味说：“看，我们都是你的骨肉。

text_en: For some time, while Saul was king over us, it was you who led out Israel and brought it in. The Lord said to you: It is you who shall be shepherd of my people Israel, you who shall be ruler over Israel. ”
text_cn: 以前，连撒乌耳当我们的君王时，也是你率领以色列出入征讨；上主曾对你说过：你应牧养我的百姓以色列，作以色列的领袖。”

text_en: So all the elders of Israel came to the king at Hebron; and King David made a covenant with them at Hebron before the Lord , and they anointed David king over Israel.
text_cn: 随后，以色列所有的长老都到赫贝龙来见君王，达味君王就在赫贝龙，当上主的面同他们立了盟约；他们便给达味傅油，立他为以色列王。

text_en: David was thirty years old when he began to reign, and he reigned forty years.
text_cn: 达味登极时已三十岁，做王四十年；

text_en: At Hebron he reigned over Judah seven years and six months; and at Jerusalem he reigned over all Israel and Judah thirty-three years.
text_cn: 在赫贝龙做犹大王，七年零六个月；在耶路撒冷做全以色列和犹大王三十三年。

text_en: The king and his men marched to Jerusalem against the Jebusites, the inhabitants of the land, who said to David, “You will not come in here, even the blind and the lame will turn you back”—thinking, “David cannot come in here. ”
text_cn: 以后，达味和他的人向耶路撒冷进发，攻打住在那地方的耶步斯人，有人告诉达味说：“你决攻不进去，因为瞎眼瘸腿的也会把你赶走。”这是说：“达味决攻不进去。”

text_en: Nevertheless David took the stronghold of Zion, which is now the city of David.
text_cn: 但是达味却占领了熙雍山堡，即达味城。

text_en: David had said on that day, “Whoever would strike down the Jebusites, let him get up the water shaft to attack the lame and the blind, those whom David hates. ” Therefore it is said, “The blind and the lame shall not come into the house. ”
text_cn: 那日达味宣布说：“凡攻打耶步斯人，从水道首先到达味所恼恨的那些瘸腿瞎眼的人那里的，他要升为军长和元帅。”责鲁雅的儿子约阿布首先上去了，因而成了元帅。但为此有句俗语说：“有瞎眼瘸腿的在此，人是进不去的！”

text_en: David occupied the stronghold, and named it the city of David. David built the city all around from the Millo inward.
text_cn: 达味住在那山堡内，称之为达味城。达味又从米罗往里，四周加建了城墙。

text_en: And David became greater and greater, for the Lord , the God of hosts, was with him.
text_cn: 达味日渐强盛，上主万军的天主与他同在。

text_en: King Hiram of Tyre sent messengers to David, along with cedar trees, and carpenters and masons who built David a house.
text_cn: 提洛王希兰派使臣来见达味，给他送来香柏木，派来了木匠石匠，为他建造宫室。

text_en: David then perceived that the Lord had established him king over Israel, and that he had exalted his kingdom for the sake of his people Israel.
text_cn: 那时，达味知道上主已坚定他为以色列王，并为了自己的百姓以色列，提高了他的王位。

text_en: In Jerusalem, after he came from Hebron, David took more concubines and wives; and more sons and daughters were born to David.
text_cn: 达味从赫贝龙迁来以后，在耶路撒冷又娶了妻妾，生了一些子女。

text_en: These are the names of those who were born to him in Jerusalem: Shammua, Shobab, Nathan, Solomon,
text_cn: 他在耶路撒冷所生儿子的名字如下：沙慕亚、芍巴布、纳堂、撒罗满、

text_en: Ibhar, Elishua, Nepheg, Japhia,
text_cn: 依贝哈尔、厄里叔亚、乃费格、雅非亚、

text_en: Elishama, Eliada, and Eliphelet.
text_cn: 厄里沙玛、厄肋雅达和厄里培肋特。

text_en: When the Philistines heard that David had been anointed king over Israel, all the Philistines went up in search of David; but David heard about it and went down to the stronghold.
text_cn: 培肋舍特人听说：达味受傅作了以色列王，遂都上来向达味寻衅；达味一听说，便下到堡垒中。

text_en: Now the Philistines had come and spread out in the valley of Rephaim.
text_cn: 培肋舍特人来到后，散布在勒法因平原内。

text_en: David inquired of the Lord , “Shall I go up against the Philistines? Will you give them into my hand? ” The Lord said to David, “Go up; for I will certainly give the Philistines into your hand. ”
text_cn: 那时达味求问上主说：“我可以上去攻打培肋舍特人吗？你将他们交在我手中吗？”上主回答达味说：“你上去，我必将培肋舍特人交在你手中。”

text_en: So David came to Baal-perazim, and David defeated them there. He said, “The Lord has burst forth against my enemies before me, like a bursting flood. ” Therefore that place is called Baal-perazim.
text_cn: 达味于是来到巴耳培辣亲，在那里击败了他们。达味因此说：“上主使我的敌人在我面前崩溃，如水破堤。”为此，后人称这地方为巴耳培辣亲。

text_en: The Philistines abandoned their idols there, and David and his men carried them away.
text_cn: 培肋舍特人把自己的神像都遗弃在那里，达味和他的人便将这些神像都带走了。

text_en: Once again the Philistines came up, and were spread out in the valley of Rephaim.
text_cn: 培肋舍特人又上来，散布在勒法因平原内。

text_en: When David inquired of the Lord , he said, “You shall not go up; go around to their rear, and come upon them opposite the balsam trees.
text_cn: 达味又求问上主，上主说：“不要上去，但要绕到他们后方，从桑林那边抄他们的后路。

text_en: When you hear the sound of marching in the tops of the balsam trees, then be on the alert; for then the Lord has gone out before you to strike down the army of the Philistines. ”
text_cn: 当你听到桑树梢上有脚步声时，你就赶快行动，因为那时正是上主在你前面出击培肋舍特人的军队。”

text_en: David did just as the Lord had commanded him; and he struck down the Philistines from Geba all the way to Gezer.
text_cn: 达味就照上主所命的行了，击杀培肋舍特人，从基贝红直到革则尔。
